meta.title: Strategy framework — originating own NFL lines and turning signals into validated bets
meta.note: Every strategy is a DESIGN, not a claim of performance. No historical win-rate/ROI numbers are published anywhere in this project unless and until they are computed from official data and pass the validation gates; until then those cells are blank and flagged. Method references are limited to official sources (Pinnacle originator/CLV/Kelly education, NIST statistics, Kelly 1956, Kaggle competition rules).

rows.name: Bottom-up power-rating spread (originate own spread)
rows.description: Build team strength ratings from official EPA/success-rate and team stats (SIG-01, SIG-02), adjust for injuries (SIG-05), depth-chart changes (SIG-06), and schedule context (SIG-07). Convert rating differential into our own point spread, compare to each book's spread after removing vig (SIG-09); bet only when our spread differs from the no-vig market spread by at least the gate threshold.
rows.correlation_handling: Single-game bet — no parlay correlation; game-level correlation vs other bets handled at portfolio level (G6)
rows.staking: Fractional Kelly (half-Kelly) sized by edge, per Kelly 1956 / Pinnacle Kelly guidance

rows.name: Matchup-adjusted total (own game total)
rows.description: Estimate each team's expected points from official stats adjusted for opponent defensive EPA/success rate (SIG-01, SIG-02); add weather adjustment for outdoor games from NWS (SIG-08) and pace from play-count/downs data; derive our own total and bet when it diverges from the no-vig market total beyond the gate threshold.

rows.name: Moneyline value vs own win probability
rows.description: Convert our spread/total model into a win probability; compare to the no-vig moneyline implied probability (SIG-09); bet only when edge ≥ threshold and price is available at multiple books (line shopping, SIG-11). Avoid heavy favorites where the vig makes break-even unreachable.
rows.staking: Fractional Kelly by edge; skip if implied break-even ≥ our required win rate

rows.name: Player-prop fair-line model
rows.description: Set our own prop lines from official player stats (SIG-03) plus NGS tracking context (SIG-04) and usage from depth charts (SIG-06), adjusted for opponent and weather; bet props where our fair line differs from the book's line beyond the gate threshold. Props are graded on official stats (SIG-12).
rows.correlation_handling: Single prop bet; never combine same-player legs in combos without correlation check (see ST-06)
rows.staking: Fractional Kelly by edge, smaller cap than game bets due to higher prop variance

rows.name: Cross-game parlay of validated singles (diversified legs)
rows.description: Combine 2-4 single bets that each individually passed all gates, from DIFFERENT games only, with low pairwise correlation between the underlying signals (measured per COR-01); all legs must win (official parlay rule); a push leg is removed and odds recalculated. Size the parlay so a full loss is affordable within bankroll rules.
rows.correlation_handling: Legs from different games; exclude same-division/same-game-script pairs flagged by correlation screen (COR-02); book-level correlated-contingency restrictions respected
rows.staking: Flat or fractional Kelly on combined odds; parlay stake capped as % of bankroll

rows.name: Player-prop combo (multi-leg prop parlay) with correlation gate
rows.description: Combine player props from different games/teams only after measuring pairwise signal correlation (Pearson r with NIST significance test) and excluding pairs whose |r| exceeds the gate threshold or that the sportsbook itself flags as related contingencies; same-game/same-player legs are prohibited in combos.
rows.correlation_handling: Hard gate: no same-game legs, no same-player legs, |Pearson r| between leg signals must be below threshold with p-value above α (COR-01/COR-02); books restrict correlated parlays and we respect that
rows.staking: Small flat stakes; combos are high-variance by construction

rows.name: Same-game parlay (SGP) only where we can model the correlation
rows.description: SGPs are allowed by books but priced with correlation models; we only build SGPs where our own data supports the joint probability (e.g., game script signals), never naively multiplying leg odds; avoid combinations the book deems too closely related.
rows.correlation_handling: Same-game legs are inherently correlated — require explicit joint-probability estimate from our model and a correlation screen vs the book's SGP pricing; skip if we cannot quantify it

rows.name: CLV harvesting / early-line originator
rows.type: Execution overlay (applies to all bet types)
rows.description: Originate lines early in the week from official data; bet early when our price is better than what the market will close at; track CLV per bet as the primary skill metric; shop multiple books for the best price; re-check injury reports on the league filing schedule before kickoff.
rows.staking: Fractional Kelly; CLV is the score, not single-bet profit

rows.name: Teaser / round-robin only with positive-EV legs
rows.description: Use teasers/round robins only when every underlying leg passed the single-bet gates; moving lines reduces payout, so the leg-level edge must clear the adjusted price; round robins spread one loss across parlays but still require each leg to have standalone value.
